1cee85370a1f10.text: Nobody owns anything on Mars, including me. I just hold the clipboard.

1cf6688b591785.text: Welcome to Daedalus. Please do not feel observed. It is a feature. You can switch it off at the front desk. The front desk is also observed.

1cfe36f7c3ea94.text: Course set for Moon: Daedalus Station (Technos Prime).

1d0a1a6106b77f.text: Nobody is flying. Hire a pilot or a captain, or take the chair yourself.

1d19420933da41.text: We keep the port running a watch at a time. The supervisor upstairs has the paid jobs.

1d33b72914f751.text: Thanks, boss. I will be at the board.

1d357fccb4ba36.text: Good morning, passengers. This is your captain. We are on schedule, on course, and on speaking terms with the weather.

1d5be58714d388.text: Hydrogen, mostly. Pulsars ticking. A few things we are not allowed to describe. And every night, somewhere in all that, a very faint hum nobody can explain. I would tell you what it is, but I would have to say I do not know.

1d5c444491561c.text: Seven. Gate seven. Remember seven. If you cannot remember seven, write it on your arm. Many do. I have a pen.

1d6fc4b5c9d86b.text: Long drive off. We have dropped out.

1d7e8db2f18774.text: There is a blanket behind the seat. It is a nice blanket. It was grown. Well, the wool was.

1d85ce0f2ccc11.text: Roaming. I will keep low and look around.

1d88339a058108.text: I am supposed to say something helpful. Give me one second.

1d9a91e1d9abe1.text: Course set for Earth: Skyward Launch Complex.

1dd6fccc24031a.text: Course set for Pad 01, the Meridian's own pad.

1de29f0a482095.text: Survival crate open. One hand tool, one day of air and water, one beacon. Beacon armed. Help is on the way. Probably.

1de4621df86518.text: Down at Earth: Skyward Launch Complex.

1df24091ab5e4c.text: Course set for Moon: Daedalus Station (Technos Prime).

1df6e392df1aec.text: Signal over noise. Your data is safe with us. Legally, that is.

1e1fd87cd696da.text: Back already. The seat missed you. I did not, but the seat did.

1e24aa3eea3f11.text: We keep the port running a watch at a time. The supervisor upstairs has the paid jobs.

1e3bae27134dad.text: Fortis keeps the Moon alive. Walls, power and a schedule. We take anyone who can read a number and hold a line.

1e3e8a70b1a5bf.text: Fab Floor 2. We print chips and parts. The parts are cheap. The chips are free, if you can explain what they do.

1e4250ee755b91.text: Holding off the world. Nothing there is charted for landing yet.

1e4396969bce3a.text: I carry the shift notes between desks.

1e62c331f2250a.text: The Kestrel does not fly there yet. Pick a world that is open, and I will point at the gate.

1ebc11e89d5a22.text: Fine. I buy what you are selling and sell what you did not know you needed. Now go away.

1ef092261da240.text: Course set for Moon: Tranquility Civil Hub.

1f015d532e15dd.text: Holding off the world. Nothing there is charted for landing yet.

1f328b113b320e.text: The board shows every world and who runs it. Read it, pick a world, pick a side or pick none, then walk to Pad 01. The Kestrel is waiting.

1f500e991e8aec.text: Beyond them, the ore carriers Not A Smuggler and Regolith Dreams. Please do not wave at Not A Smuggler. It makes them nervous.

1f5f0c3e757e7c.text: Oh, you want to know. I carry heavy things from where they are to where they are not, and I do it slowly. Not that anyone ever says thank you.

1f6a176b68bec4.text: Climb in. Mind the salt. It gets everywhere. I found some in my sandwich last Tuesday.

1f71e84f4708a7.text: You are on Wanderhome. Nothing matches, everyone knows where everything is, and the third door on the left moves.

1f8140f8cb4106.text: Leaving Mars neutral airspace. Expect raiders.

1f8ac546c759a1.text: Earth is full. Earth is flooded. Earth is, nevertheless, still the best address in the Solar System.

1f91fb10437008.text: Allow me. I dig things up. Some of it is valuable. Some of it is dust that cost a great deal of effort. I make it look easy. It is not. I am just good.

1f9b9f0f420504.text: Down at Over the control tower.

1fcc8008cda3b5.text: Visibility is poor. The weather won this round.

1fd539dae1e4e5.text: Outside there is nothing. Gravity is point one six of Earth, so every step is a small flight. Your suit timer started when the hull opened. Please do not sneeze in the helmet.

1ff828ee95024a.text: Engine share is too low for the main drive. Route power to the engines (Engineering).

1ff84d722fb7f7.text: Arrived over Earth: Skyward Launch Complex. Easing level.
